name: 烛前垂眸
description: 站姿，双手在胸前交叠，低头垂眸，眼半闭。适合暗场、祈祷、告别这类安静场面。
pose_tags: standing, hands clasped, hands in front, head down, looking down, lowered gaze, eyes half closed, calm expression, closed mouth, upper body
notes: `lowered gaze` 与 `looking at viewer` 互斥，必须负面锁掉后者，否则模型会把头抬起来看镜头（实测）。`eyes half closed` 是让眼睛不出高光的关键，配合 `calm expression` 一起写。
